verdict.rationale: Mercury lets you retrieve cards and, via the Cards API, 'manage spending limits and control card lifecycle states' (mercury-docs-1, mercury-docs-36), which plausibly covers freezing/deactivating a card, but there is no explicit documentation of a 'freeze card' action or of ordering a physical replacement card for a lost/stolen card. missing for 10: explicit freeze/lock card documentation, explicit lost/stolen card replacement flow, UI or API evidence of the finance-lead-facing freeze button.
